private_knowledge.title: 色彩构成：70-20-10 色板比例黄金法则
private_knowledge.body: 画面色彩严格遵循 70% 主导底色（稳住大体量与环境基调）、20% 辅助次色（区分结构层级与透气过渡）、10% 高对比点缀色（仅用于视觉中心与核心识别锚点）；严禁未经授权的高饱和荧光/霓虹杂色乱入破坏色调统一。

private_knowledge.title: 人体结构：头身比尺规与重心控制
private_knowledge.body: 写实/二次元立绘标准锁定 7~8 头身（常用 7.5 头身），Q版锁定 2~3 头身；草图阶段必须先标头顶、下巴、胸线、胯部、膝盖五道刻度线并校核重心垂线，严禁头肩比例失调或幼态大头漂移。

  · [palette-70-20-10] 色彩构成：70-20-10 色板比例黄金法则: 画面色彩严格遵循 70% 主导底色（稳住大体量与环境基调）、20% 辅助次色（区分结构层级与透气过渡）、10% 高对比点缀色（仅用于视觉中心与核心识别锚点）；严禁未经授权的高饱和荧光/霓虹杂色乱入破坏色调统一。
  · [anatomy-head-ratio] 人体结构：头身比尺规与重心控制: 写实/二次元立绘标准锁定 7~8 头身（常用 7.5 头身），Q版锁定 2~3 头身；草图阶段必须先标头顶、下巴、胸线、胯部、膝盖五道刻度线并校核重心垂线，严禁头肩比例失调或幼态大头漂移。

reasonableness.draft_prompt: Clay fairy winter farm, farmer holding lamb, soft cute style.
reasonableness.revised_prompt: A brand-new winter farm snowfield scene in fairy-garden clay fairytale style (lock medium/palette-role/lighting/material grammar from the style reference only; do NOT copy that garden layout, mole character, petal house, creek, mushroom table, or giant tropical leaves). Vertical 9:16. Mid shot, slight high angle over a snowy farmyard. Center: round clay Q-version farmer (~2.5 heads) standing in smooth matte white polymer-clay snow, both arms cradling a small fluffy clay lamb against the chest with clear hand-to-wool contact; farmer gaze soft toward the lamb. Farmer: short rounded limbs, bean torso, rosy cheeks, large irises with visible colored iris rings plus white specular highlights (NO solid black-dot pupils), cream-and-berry knit hat and scarf. Lamb: rounded clay wool clumps, tiny tucked legs, pink nose, iris eyes with highlights. Snow = smooth matte white clay slabs with soft AO contact shadows under boots, not powdered sugar, not crystalline ice. Background budget: one small rounded doughy clay barn with single arched door, few fence posts, pastel peach-lavender winter sky, sparse rounded clay evergreens only 鈥?no tropical foliage. Soft high-key studio glow + gentle AO, warm snow bounce, no neon. Smooth matte clay/soft-plastic rounded edges everywhere, shallow DOF. Palette: cream snow ~70%, warm wood + muted evergreen ~20%, berry pink/soft purple accents ~10%. Commercial miniature fairytale mobile finish, clean silhouette. Continuous arm joints; sheep limbs as sheep not human elbows. Solid scenic background, no text, no watermark.
